notes.title: 2.0 Update: Now supporting the Oculus Rift and WMR!
notes.notes:
[h1]Beach Bowling Dream VR now supports Oculus Rift and Windows Mixed Reality headsets in addition to the HTC Vive and Vive Pro.[/h1]

Other updates in this release include:
[list]
[*] Artificially increased throwing velocity by 20% to improve feel
[*] Added splash effect when items hit the water in Walk The Plank mode
[*] Improved friction interaction between cannonballs and sand
[*] Patched area where waves were peeking through the sand
[*] Minor performance improvements for lower-end systems
[/list]

[i]Note: SteamVR is required to run on all systems. 360° sensor setup is recommended for the Rift, but front facing sensors will work.[/i]

notes.title: Heads-up! 50% off sale coming soon! (50％折扣！)
notes.notes:
Here in the northern and mid-atlantic regions of the East Coast of the US, we just got hit with a late snow storm.  What better way to beat the cold than to head to a tropical island...to bowl! For the week starting March 20th, Beach Bowling Dream VR will be on sale for 50% off. Don't miss out!

Since the game has also been popular in China:

享受折扣 50%，2017 年 3 月 20 日 ！

Hopefully I didn't butcher that too much. :)
